observed.caption: A lily-covered pond in an urban park with tall city buildings and trees in the background under a pale evening sky.
observed.description: The foreground shows a grassy bank leading to a pond partially covered with lily pads and dark reflective water. Scattered trees including a flat-topped acacia on the left and palm trees on the right surround the pond, with a small turquoise footbridge crossing a narrow section on the right. In the midground more trees and open grass are visible, and in the background a cluster of tall yellow-brown high-rise buildings rises above the treeline with smaller white buildings nearby. Overhead cables stretch across the middle of the scene and the sky is pale with light clouds.
